areas.title: Pipi7íyekw (Cerise Creek Old-Growth and Sensitive Area)
areas.why: Líl̓wat Nation. A 2019 provincial order protects the cultural heritage resources here for First Nations' food, social and ceremonial use. Next door, Pipi7íyekw / Joffre Lakes Park closes on set dates so the Líl̓wat Nation and N'Quatqua can use the land for cultural practices: June 20–27 and September 8–30 in 2026. Check BC Parks for current dates before you go.

sources.label: Land Use Objectives for Pipi7iyekw, Ministerial Order M007 (Province of BC, 2019)
Pipi7íyekw / Joffre Lakes Park (BC Parks)

areas.title: Callaghan
areas.why: A First Nations' Cultural Management Area in the Sea to Sky land-use plan: an area with high First Nations cultural values, where use and development are meant to protect those values. Recreation isn't banned. The Callaghan sits in territory of both the Líl̓wat and Squamish Nations.

sources.label: Sea to Sky Land and Resource Management Plan (Province of BC)
Sea-to-Sky land use objectives order (Province of BC, 2011)
